root_cause.text: During NVMe controller reset, nvme_alloc_admin_tag_set() overwrites ctrl->admin_q without first releasing the existing admin queue, leaking the previous request_queue.
root_cause.evidence: The patch explicitly adds `if (ctrl->admin_q) blk_put_queue(ctrl->admin_q);` before assigning the new queue, with the comment: "If a previous admin queue exists (e.g., from before a reset), put it now before allocating a new one to avoid orphaning it." This indicates the root cause is the missing release of the old queue.
